headline: Release truth is now staged, browser-proven, source-validated, and honest about the remaining Obelisk gap.

items.title: Fresh-reader startup projection
items.insight: The next session no longer inherits the closing session's context exhaustion as committed truth.

items.title: Mobile navigation close authority
items.insight: The same control now opens and closes cleanly with correct z-order, ARIA, backdrop, and scroll state.

items.title: Staging recovery and release truth
items.insight: Hetzner staging moved from 404 to candidate-green while production parity stays separately honest.

items.title: Route-scoped exact-byte CSP
items.insight: 157 bounded route policies protect static staging without a global over-authorizing hash union.

items.title: Public signal coalescing
items.insight: Fresh-browser traffic now issues exactly one request per shared public signal.

items.title: Canonical footer contract
items.insight: The complete Studio footer is consistent and source-gated across 108 pages.

items.title: Unified hard-fail resilience
items.insight: Complementary failure classes now share one prevention umbrella instead of recurring as one-off fixes.

items.title: Obelisk posture truth-corrected
items.insight: The repo can no longer call isolated, behaviorally broken scaffolding a completed identity integration.

items.title: Closeout score truth
items.insight: SIL max is derived and absent genome dimensions are unscored, never fabricated zero.

items.title: Vault Wall native-list accessibility
items.insight: The public Forge Feed retains real list semantics and the exact prior Lighthouse failure is browser-gated.

items.title: Blocking staging Lighthouse truth
items.insight: A failed staging audit can no longer hide beneath a successful workflow conclusion.
